notes.title: LOVE ON Patch #4
notes.content:
Hello,

We are pleased to announce the fourth patch for Love ON. The improvements in this patch are as follows:

1. Steam Achievement Fixes
   - Resolved the issue with unlocking the "Peeking at Outfit Changing" achievement.
2. Samsung Odyssey, WMR Device Button Addition
   - The previous A button is now mapped to the Trackpad Push button.
3. Beach Rendering Fix
   - Fixed the issue where background image boundaries were visible.
4. Store Description Update
   - Removed and corrected inaccurate information about the game.
5. Halloween Update
   - Added Halloween pumpkin decorations to the title level (Goshiwon Room).
   - Changed the background screen for the title menu.
6. Collision Adjustment for Miyuki’s Hair
   - Adjusted the collision so that Miyuki’s hair no longer clips through her body during level loading.
7. Chapter 1 Animation Fix for Miyuki
   - Improved the animation where Miyuki is threatened.
8. Chapter 1 Dust Fix on Miyuki
   - Corrected the color of the dust on Miyuki’s body.
9. Miscellaneous Bug and Texture Fixes
   - Fixed other minor bugs and some texture issues.

Thank you for your trust and support for the game.
LOVE ON is committed to continuous updates to improve the game and ensure player satisfaction.

For bugs, errors, or any other issues that need fixing, feel free to reach out on the Love ON Discord.

Thank you.

LOVE ON DISCORD - https://discord.com/invite/VEDQRDbxfk

notes.title: LOVE ON Price change & Patch notice
notes.content:
Hello,

We sincerely appreciate all the love and support you have shown for LOVE ON.

For our VR game and visual novel fans, we have maintained the "Early Access" price of USD $17.99 for about a month after the official launch.

Now, with the next patch, we will be updating the price to the official launch price of USD $19.99.

Until this weekend, we will maintain the current price of USD $17.99, so we encourage any interested users to take advantage of this final opportunity.

In addition to the price increase, the game has also been improved in the following areas:

1. NPC Detail Polishing
ㄴThe modeling, textures, materials, and animations of NPCs in Ch.02 Classroom, Ch.04 Beach, and Ch.05 Festival have been updated.
ㄴWe have significantly improved the previously rather flat NPCs.

2. Build and Resource Optimization
ㄴWe are continuously working to modify the game for a more stable gameplay experience. We appreciate your additional feedback!

3. Other Bug Fixes
ㄴWe have corrected issues that were affecting in-game cinematics and gameplay progression.

We are grateful for the diverse feedback and support. LOVE ON will continue to be updated and improved to satisfy our players.

Thank you.

The VR dating simulation game LOVE ON has been officially released.
We would like to thank all the players who have been waiting for the official release, and especially extend our gratitude to the many fans who supported us through the Demo and Early Access.

We wanted to create the NEXT in the dating simulation genre that we've all dreamed of.
The release of LOVE ON is not the end of that journey but the beginning.
We ask for your continued interest and love in the future.

The direction for updates and management of LOVE ON after the official release is as follows:

  1. Bug fixes and stabilization
  2. UX improvements and various convenience features added
  3. Addition of Miyuki’s outfits and accessories

Lastly, we aim to continuously improve the game through various ideas and feedback from our players.
Please share your thoughts on the LOVE ON store board or the official Discord.

Thank you.
